report:
Urinary bladder, prostate and seminal vesicles, radical cystoprostatectomy

Received in formalin is a radical cystoprostatectomy specimen measuring 12.5 x 9.5 x 7.0 cm. Opening the bladder reveals a 42 mm ulcerated tumour involving the right lateral wall and posterior wall. Attached organs: prostate and seminal vesicles grossly unremarkable. Sections are submitted in 18 blocks.

(A1-A2) right and left ureteral margins.
(A3) urethral margin.
(A4-A11) bladder tumour full thickness with perivesical fat.
(A12-A14) representative bladder mucosa.
(A15-A16) prostate and seminal vesicles.
(A17-A18) bilateral pelvic lymph nodes.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Radical cystoprostatectomy
- Tumour site: Right lateral wall and posterior wall
- Tumour size (greatest dimension): 42 mm
- Tumour configuration: Ulcerated

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Urothelial carcinoma, conventional (invasive)
- Histologic grade: High-grade
- Associated urothelial carcinoma in situ (UCIS): Present, focal
- Tumour extension (depth of invasion): Deep muscularis propria, outer half
  (pT2b)
- Prostatic involvement (if cystoprostatectomy): Not identified
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Tumour histology:
  Sections of the urinary bladder show urothelial carcinoma, conventional (invasive), high-grade. Irregular nests and sheets of pleomorphic urothelial cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and frequent mitoses infiltrate through the lamina propria into the bladder wall.

Margins
- Surgical margins: All margins uninvolved by invasive carcinoma and CIS
  - Right ureteral margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma and CIS
  - Left ureteral margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma and CIS
  - Urethral margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma and CIS
  - Perivesical soft tissue margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma
- Distance to closest margin: 8 mm (right posterolateral perivesical soft
  tissue)

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 0 of 18 involved (bilateral pelvic (obturator and
  external iliac))

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT2b pN0

Additional findings
- Additional pathologic findings: Cystitis cystica et glandularis

URINARY BLADDER, prostate and seminal vesicles, radical cystoprostatectomy:
- UROTHELIAL CARCINOMA, high-grade, 42 mm
- Tumour invades deep muscularis propria, outer half
- Associated urothelial carcinoma in situ (present, focal)
- Surgical margins clear of invasive carcinoma and CIS
- 0 of 18 regional lymph nodes involved
- pT2b pN0 (AJCC 8th edition).
